results.exact_unused_slice: Using an internalized-reasoning long-context VLM to reason directly over the rendered FastQC/MultiQC visual report (the plots/tables as images) jointly with free-text experiment context (assay type, application, intended downstream use) to render a contextual sample-level fail-for-THIS-application call AND an explicit is-a-rerun-warranted judgment. Existing ML touches the application only via classical classifiers on extracted numeric features (seqQscorer, FFPE decision trees) or adaptive thresholding (miQC) -- none reason over the visual report itself, none ingest experiment/application context as free text, and none output a rerun-eligibility decision; AI MultiQC products (NonStop) only summarize/surface, they do not adjudicate rerun.
results.honest_adjacency: Strong on BOTH axes. Application axis: automated sequencing-QC pass/fail / problematic-sample judgment is already a deployed ML task (seqQscorer is a named tool; FFPE decision-tree predicts QC pass/fail status; miQC does context-dependent QC), plus a commercial 'AI assistance for MultiQC' product exists. Technique-family axis: VLM-as-a-judge over scientific figures against rubrics (arXiv 2511.14631) and VLM data-visualization understanding are an active sibling space. The unused intersection is narrow but real (visual-report reasoning + experiment-context + rerun decision).
results.reasoning: Cannot be OPEN: reformulations hit a named deployed ML tool for the exact application family (seqQscorer), a published decision-tree model predicting QC pass/fail, and an AI/commercial MultiQC-interpretation product, plus a VLM-judges-figures sibling for the technique. The remaining headroom is genuinely the VLM-reasons-over-the-visual-report-plus-context-for-a-rerun-call slice, which I found no instance of -- but adjacency on both axes is unambiguous, so NARROW, not OPEN. Note: this contradicts the framing of C1 as the 'key OPEN candidate'; the application is more penetrated than 'very-low' suggests (classical-ML QC scoring is well established), though the specific visual-reasoning+rerun framing is unclaimed.

results.exact_unused_slice: Active/abductive CAUSAL-DISCOVERY (HOLOGRAPH-style LLM-causal-prior + sheaf alignment, or any causal-graph method) that ingests the UNSTRUCTURED FREE TEXT of many cases' trawling/hypothesis-generating interview recall and abductively nominates a food vehicle. Existing automated work operates on STRUCTURED inputs: random forest on demographic/outbreak characteristics from FDOSS surveillance records (Vehicle Prediction Tool), or Bayesian variable selection / logistic case-control on tabulated exposure tables. LLM work on outbreaks is information-extraction/surveillance/classification, not causal-discovery-driven vehicle nomination. The open-ended interview free text is explicitly not yet NLP-processed for vehicle hypothesis generation, and no causal-discovery method (active or otherwise) is applied to this abductive nomination step.
results.honest_adjacency: Strong on BOTH axes. Application axis: a deployed, free, public ML tool ALREADY does foodborne-outbreak food-vehicle hypothesis generation (random forest Vehicle Prediction Tool), and Bayesian/data-mining methods already identify outbreak food sources. Technique-family axis: LLM-priors-over-unstructured-outbreak-text is an active area (epidemic information extraction, social-media epi classification), and causal/Bayesian source-attribution is established. The unclaimed slice is the union (causal-discovery over the interview FREE TEXT for abductive vehicle nomination), not either axis alone.
results.reasoning: Cannot be OPEN: the very application (food-vehicle hypothesis generation) is a named, deployed, publicly available ML product, and the technique family (LLM priors on unstructured outbreak text + Bayesian causal source attribution) has clear siblings on this exact domain. PulseNet (genomic clustering) and SaTScan/Epi Info (cluster detection / analytic studies) are the manual/structured incumbents the candidate flagged, all confirmed present. The specific causal-discovery-on-free-text-recall framing appears unclaimed (NLP on open-ended interview responses explicitly not found), giving real but narrow headroom => NARROW.
